reason: The picture links the muscle-development messengers to activating muscle genes in the target cells, which is a starting point for making pulling proteins.
expectation: The messengers should guide some cells toward becoming muscle cells.

alternatives.reason: That could start the separate goal of making supporting fibres.

effect: The messengers produced cells on their way to becoming muscle cells, with RNA instructions for proteins still to be made.
reaction: The picture makes the next protein-building step fairly clear.
reason: Amino acids are protein building blocks, and the precursor cells have instructions for muscle proteins.
expectation: The cells should use the amino acids to make muscle proteins.

effect: The amino acids helped make pulling proteins inside the muscle precursors, completing that goal.
reaction: The picture of overlapping fibres makes their pulling job clearer.
reason: The remaining goal is supporting fibres, and the messenger picture links these chemicals to support-protein genes in the unspecialized cells.
expectation: The messengers should guide some cells toward becoming supporting cells.

effect: The supporting-cell messengers produced fibre-producing cells with RNA instructions for support proteins, but no fibre network yet.
reaction: This parallels the muscle-cell pathway, so the next step seems clear.
reason: Amino acids are protein building blocks, and these cells have instructions for support proteins.
expectation: The cells should use the amino acids to make supporting fibres around themselves.

effect: The fibre-producing cells made supporting connective tissue, completing the remaining goal. The result showed that cells can release proteins around themselves rather than keeping them inside.
reaction: The contrast with the muscle cells helped the two pathways make sense.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the pulling proteins was worthwhile because the overlapping fibres showed how the proteins could help a cell shorten.

leastWorthwhile.text: The supporting-cell pathway felt a little repetitive after the muscle pathway, though the final result showed an important difference.

surprise.text: I was interested that cells with the same DNA could use different genes and put their proteins in different places.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the messenger pictures and protein-building-block label explained the pairings.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the separate muscle cells are assembled into larger fibres, since the picture mentioned that as a later step.
